status: Fixed BEFORE training pool v3 and frozen test v3 exist. Any change after hashing requires protocol_version 2.0 and a NEW test set.

scope.role: Advisory only. A classifier output must never by itself produce a definitive high-risk / fraud decision. Person 2's decision engine is not modified.
scope.retired_benchmark: data/real_world_test_v1.csv is retired from all selection and tuning; it may be evaluated once for the final selected model AFTER the sealed evaluation, reported separately as historical.

IMC25.title: Fishing for Smishing (Agarwal, Papasavva, Suarez-Tangil, Vasek; ACM IMC 2025; doi:10.1145/3730567.3764431)
IMC25.licence: CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE.txt sha256 7e7170e3cebf88a9f60c7b8421418323c09304da1af4d5e90f4da1dc1c8a2661; README; paper Appendix B)
IMC25.attribution: Agarwal, S., Papasavva, A., Suarez-Tangil, G., Vasek, M. (2025). Fishing for Smishing: Understanding SMS Phishing Infrastructure and Strategies by Mining Public User Reports. IMC '25. Dataset: github.com/reportsmishing/Smishing-Dataset-IMC25 (CC BY 4.0). Modified: anonymised (anon-v1), filtered, deduplicated.
IMC25.language_filter: language == 'English' only (legitimate sources are English; other languages would become a label shortcut)
IMC25.long_digit_investigation: Before masking, every run of >= 10 digits is classified (10-digit mobile / 0-prefixed landline / +country code / other id) and counted in the build report; all are then masked by anon-v1.

DONATION.description: Voluntarily donated genuine institutional messages (CONSENT-v1, docs/donation/), masked locally by scripts/donate_messages.py and reviewed by the donor.
DONATION.label: legitimate
DONATION.files: data/donations/donation_<donor_id>.csv (gitignored); withdrawn donors excluded via consent_ledger.csv status

MWOZ_TRAIN.title: MultiWOZ 2.2 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2019 Pawel Budzianowski)
MWOZ_TRAIN.sampling: 300 dialogues (sorted by id, shuffled with seed 20261024), one USER and one SYSTEM turn of >= 5 words each
MWOZ_TRAIN.label: legitimate

MWOZ_TEST.file_sha256: recorded in the build report at download time
MWOZ_TEST.sampling: 150 dialogues (sorted by id, shuffled with seed 20261025), one USER and one SYSTEM turn of >= 5 words each
MWOZ_TEST.label: legitimate

anonymisation.applied_to: Every row of every source, both classes, train and test. Models trained under this protocol record preprocessing='anon-v1' in metadata and classify_text() must apply anonymise() before vectorising (implemented and tested before final evaluation).
anonymisation.check: Build report lists, per source and label, the rate of each placeholder token (urltoken, phonetoken, emailtoken, upitoken, datetoken, numtoken) so remaining asymmetries are visible.

build_order: 1. Download pinned sources; verify SHA-256; never modify raw files.
2. Map labels; exclude ambiguous labels and non-English IMC25 rows; log every exclusion with reason.
3. Investigate and count >= 10-digit runs (IMC25), then anonymise all rows with anon-v1.

4. Remove rows overlapping the retired benchmark (data/real_world_test_v1.csv) or the challenge suite: exact normalised, skeleton, or skeleton-token Jaccard >= 0.8 (compared after anonymising both sides). Includes the 199 known IMC25 skeleton overlaps.

5. Exact normalised de-duplication across all sources, keeping the first by source priority DONATION > IMC25 > MWOZ_TEST > MWOZ_TRAIN > R115 > SYN; identical text with conflicting labels -> all copies excluded.

8. Cross-split leakage check between test and train rows (exact normalised, skeleton, Jaccard >= 0.8). Any hit removes the TRAIN group(s) containing it; the test set is never altered by this step. Repeat until zero hits.
10. Write pool and test; seal (see sealing). Build report contains counts only, never test message text.

grouping.template_clustering: Within each source, rows are linked when the token sets of skeleton_text(anonymised text) have Jaccard >= 0.6. Candidate pairs are restricted to rows sharing at least one of their 3 rarest tokens (document frequency within the source). Groups = connected components of base-key links and template links (union-find).
grouping.group_id: <source>:<smallest stable row key in the component> (IMC25 row number, donation id, dialogue id, R115 row_id, SYN line)

test_assignment.rule: For IMC25 and DONATION groups: u = int(sha256(salt + '|' + group_id).hexdigest()[:8], 16) / 2**32; the group is TEST if u < 0.20, otherwise TRAIN. MWOZ_TEST rows are all TEST; MWOZ_TRAIN, R115 and SYN rows are all TRAIN.
test_assignment.properties: No model output, metric or manual choice influences assignment. The frozen test contains real sources only (IMC25, DONATION, MWOZ_TEST).

minimum_legitimate_coverage.collection_target: >= 750 approved donated messages from >= 10 donors (expected ~150 in test at 20%).
minimum_legitimate_coverage.test_requirement: Frozen test must contain >= 150 donated messages from >= 5 donors, with >= 3 categories having >= 25 messages each.
minimum_legitimate_coverage.if_not_met: Criterion L1 is reported as NOT EVALUABLE; the model can at most be reported as 'scam recall evaluated; false positives on genuine Indian financial alerts NOT validated'. No synthetic or substitute data may be presented as real genuine alerts.

model_selection.data: Pool v3 TRAIN rows only. The frozen test is never read (enforced by the sealed-file guard in text_classifier.load_dataset / load_evaluation_dataset).
model_selection.cv: StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42) over pool groups

candidates.A_v1_config: word 1-2-grams, letters-only tokens, sublinear TF, C=1.0, class_weight=balanced
candidates.G_char_wb_3_5: char_wb 3-5-grams, min_df=2, sublinear TF, C=1.0, class_weight=balanced

model_selection.rule: Maximise pooled out-of-fold macro-F1 among candidates whose out-of-fold false-positive rate on DONATION rows is <= 0.10 (constraint applied only if the pool has >= 50 DONATION rows). Ties within 0.005 macro-F1 -> lower out-of-fold legitimate FPR -> alphabetical.
model_selection.final_training: Selected configuration trained with text_classifier.train on pool v3 (its internal grouped 25% holdout is reported) into satyalens_analysis/models/candidates/v3/. The deployed artifact is not replaced by this protocol.

acceptance_criteria.conventions: Inconclusive suspicious rows count as MISSES (not detected); inconclusive legitimate rows count as NOT false positives. Each criterion reports numerator and denominator.
acceptance_criteria.S1: Suspicious recall on IMC25 test rows >= 0.80
acceptance_criteria.S2: Suspicious recall on India-linked IMC25 test rows >= 0.80
acceptance_criteria.L1: False-positive rate on DONATION test rows <= 0.10 (requires minimum coverage, else NOT EVALUABLE)
acceptance_criteria.B1: Macro-F1 on the full test strictly greater than both the rule-engine baseline and the majority-class baseline on the same test
acceptance_criteria.verdict: VALIDATED only if S1, S2, L1, L2, M1 and B1 all pass. If L1 is NOT EVALUABLE: at most 'PARTIALLY EVALUATED — not validated for genuine financial alerts'. Any failure: 'NOT VALIDATED'. Even if VALIDATED, the classifier remains advisory-only.

sealing.manifest: reports/frozen_test_v3_manifest.json with sealed_files [{path, sha256}], protocol_file 'docs/protocol_v3.json', protocol_sha256, evaluation_log 'reports/frozen_test_v3_evaluations.jsonl', row/group/label counts per source.
sealing.guard: Once the manifest exists, text_classifier.load_dataset and load_evaluation_dataset raise SealedDataError for the sealed file or any byte-identical copy (SHA-256), unless called by evaluate(final_sealed=True).
sealing.one_shot: evaluate --final-sealed-evaluation refuses to run if the protocol hash differs from the manifest, if the sealed file changed, or if the evaluation log already has an entry.
sealing.script_rule: Selection and training scripts must load data only through the package loaders and must not reference frozen_test_v3.csv; enforced by tests.
sealing.after_evaluation: Results are reported against the criteria as-is. No tuning against the test. A further evaluation requires protocol 2.0 and a new test set.

withdrawal.before_sealing: Remove the donor's rows and rebuild.
withdrawal.after_sealing_before_evaluation: Delete the rows, rebuild pool and test under the same protocol (same salt), write a new manifest; record the reseal in the build report.
withdrawal.after_evaluation: Delete the rows and any copies; keep published aggregates; annotate the report that a donor withdrew.

deviations: Any deviation from this protocol (sources, anonymiser, thresholds, candidates, selection rule, assignment) after hashing must be recorded with reason; it requires a new protocol version and a new frozen test set if made after the test exists.
